roster.name: Announced
roster.note: Russia declares it will leave the ISS partnership and build its own national station — a return to the go-it-alone model of Salyut and Mir

roster.name: First module
roster.note: the planned launch of the core module of the Russian Orbital Station (ROS) into a high-inclination polar orbit, chosen to see all of Russian territory

roster.name: ISS withdrawal
roster.note: Russia's stated timeline for ending its participation in the ISS and shifting its cosmonauts to its own station
